MediaPipe Tasks Vision @mediapipe/tasks-vision 1.1.1 (npm), Apache-2.0, vendored unmodified (vision_bundle.mjs + SIMD wasm only).
Model: BlazeFace short-range float16 (blaze_face_short_range.tflite), from storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models, Apache-2.0.
All files are served from this app; nothing is fetched from a CDN.
